**Assumption I made:** there is no edit time limit, so a comment can be edited at any time. This matches the spec's "Do not enforce one."

**Changes:** none. There is no rule to follow, so the comment edit code and its tests already match the repository. I did not run the tests, since I cannot run them in this session.

**Also checked:** the working-tree diff has no em dashes.

**To settle it:** the team needs to state the window in the spec or in a rules document. If that document is the missing `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` or another file outside this directory, please add it so I can check it.
